title: Prescriptions & Renewals coverage allowance under a controlled-substance agreement, by financial class
content:
**Revenue cycle payer-class note — Prescriptions & Renewals controlled prescriptions.**

When the patient signs a new controlled-substance agreement, the coverage allowance follows the financial class recorded on the patient's billing account — the Patient Financial Account — on the signing day: a Commercial PPO/POS Account or a Commercial HMO/EPO Account allows 30 days; a Medicare Advantage Account or a Medicare Part B Account allows 28 days; a Medicaid Managed Care Account allows 21 days; any other financial class allows the starting 14 days.

| Financial class on the Patient Financial Account | Coverage allowance |
|---|---|
| Commercial PPO/POS Account | 30 days |
| Commercial HMO/EPO Account | 30 days |
| Medicare Advantage Account | 28 days |
| Medicare Part B Account | 28 days |
| Medicaid Managed Care Account | 21 days |
| any other financial class | 14 days |

**Notes.** The class is read from the Patient Financial Account as recorded on the signing day. Each named class maps to exactly one figure; a class not named in the table takes 14 days.

**Illustration (hypothetical).** A patient whose Patient Financial Account is a Medicare Advantage Account signs a new agreement: the coverage allowance is 28 days.
